assumptions: 所有请求等长、相同位置 ID、无跨请求前缀共享，无 TP/PP；dropout=0 推理。
全模型权重统一 weight_bytes 的教学格式；不由 torch_dtype 推断实际量化格式。
每行 operator 成本为一次出现，repeats 是层数；布局视图与 GQA repeat 不额外物化。
FMA=2；matrix_flops 是有效因果矩阵工作，scalar_flops 是声明算法的普通算术；特殊函数另列。
operator 读写是独立算子操作数载荷，分数／概率矩形物化；不是实测 HBM、不是全图流量下界。
标量行内中间量视为片上；矩形注意力同时报告，FlashAttention/tile/缓存流量由执行专题另算。
不计采样、tokenizer、kernel launch、分配器、KV 管理索引及后端工作区；不据此声称完整 token 时间。
Each layer uses the explicitly reported same histogram. Balanced/concentrated are scenarios, not measured routing or inferred probabilities.
Top-k choices per token are distinct; no token drop, capacity padding, shared experts, auxiliary training loss or expert parallel communication.
Expert matrices list every expert including empty ones. Operator rows sum variable-M GEMMs without padding; actual grouped kernels and execution order may differ.
Routing includes reference FP32 softmax, selection, renormalization/cast, int64 one_hot/where, gather, probability weighting and zero/index_add combination.
Top-k is counted as a selection primitive with candidates/rows, not a fabricated comparison FLOP count. Runtime bookkeeping and conversion instruction counts remain backend-dependent.

operators.name: embedding
operators.notes: 每 token 一次行查找，不读取整个词表；重复 token 是否缓存未假定。int64 输入索引。

operators.name: rope_table
operators.notes: 同位置 ID 批共享，所有层复用；inv_freq 固定不计初始化。参考路径复制频率后求 sin/cos；转换另计。

operators.name: input_layernorm
operators.notes: 按 FP32 行内归约的代数计数；rsqrt、类型转换与临时 FP32 张量分列／不推断 HBM spill。

operators.name: q_proj
operators.notes: 独立 GEMM：权重与输入各读一次、输出写一次的操作数载荷；不预测 tile 重读。

operators.name: k_proj
operators.notes: 独立 GEMM：权重与输入各读一次、输出写一次的操作数载荷；不预测 tile 重读。

operators.name: v_proj
operators.notes: 独立 GEMM：权重与输入各读一次、输出写一次的操作数载荷；不预测 tile 重读。

operators.name: q_norm
operators.notes: 按 FP32 行内归约的代数计数；rsqrt、类型转换与临时 FP32 张量分列／不推断 HBM spill。

operators.name: k_norm
operators.notes: 按 FP32 行内归约的代数计数；rsqrt、类型转换与临时 FP32 张量分列／不推断 HBM spill。

operators.name: apply_rope
operators.notes: 2 multiply + 1 add/元素，rotate_half 符号翻转分列；表按批／头理想复用。

operators.name: kv_append
operators.notes: 原位／分页 append 载荷；不假定动态 torch.cat 对旧缓存整段复制。

operators.name: qk
operators.notes: FLOPs 仅有效因果位置；载荷是假定 Q/K 各读一次、GQA 头共享，完整分数矩阵物化。

operators.name: score_scale_mask_softmax
operators.notes: 选择的融合 scale/mask/softmax 代数工作；屏蔽点不计 exp。物化 FP32 默认概率；非具体 eager trace。

operators.name: pv
operators.notes: PV/AV：各 Q 头仍计算；V 容量不乘 GQA 复制数。载荷假定 V 在头／查询之间理想复用。

operators.name: o_proj
operators.notes: 独立 GEMM：权重与输入各读一次、输出写一次的操作数载荷；不预测 tile 重读。

operators.name: post_attention_layernorm
operators.notes: 按 FP32 行内归约的代数计数；rsqrt、类型转换与临时 FP32 张量分列／不推断 HBM spill。

operators.name: router
operators.notes: 独立 GEMM：权重与输入各读一次、输出写一次的操作数载荷；不预测 tile 重读。

operators.name: router_softmax
operators.notes: FP32 softmax: subtract max, exp, reduction, divide; casts are not FLOPs.

operators.name: router_topk
operators.notes: Top-k is an explicit selection primitive; candidate counts are not comparisons or FLOPs. Backend selection algorithm is unspecified.

operators.name: router_renormalize_cast
operators.notes: Selected probabilities are renormalized if norm_topk_prob, then cast to activation dtype; row reduction assumed on-chip.

operators.name: routing_one_hot
operators.notes: Pinned HF reference materializes one_hot int64; this large routing mask is not assumed in optimized dispatch.

operators.name: routing_where
operators.notes: Scan each expert mask; two int64 coordinates per assignment. Permute is a view.

operators.name: expert_gather
operators.notes: Logical gathers summed over experts; n_e and each concrete GEMM shape are in expert_matrices.

operators.name: expert_gate_proj
operators.notes: Sum of unpadded per-expert GEMMs; each visited expert weight read once per layer, not once per token.

operators.name: expert_up_proj
operators.notes: Sum of unpadded per-expert GEMMs; each visited expert weight read once per layer, not once per token.

operators.name: expert_down_proj
operators.notes: Unpadded per-expert GEMMs; empty experts have zero arithmetic and no weight payload.

operators.name: expert_probability_multiply
operators.notes: Probability broadcast reuses one value per assignment; int64 token/slot indices included.

operators.name: expert_output_zero
operators.notes: Reference initializes final_hidden_states to zero.

operators.name: expert_index_add
operators.notes: Reference index_add includes the first add into zero; destination read/update per assignment is logical payload, not measured HBM.

operators.name: final_norm
operators.notes: 按 FP32 行内归约的代数计数；rsqrt、类型转换与临时 FP32 张量分列／不推断 HBM spill。

operators.name: lm_head
operators.notes: 独立 GEMM：权重与输入各读一次、输出写一次的操作数载荷；不预测 tile 重读。
